name: Motion
description: Motion is an AI-powered productivity platform that combines calendar scheduling, task management, and project planning into a single, automatically optimized schedule.
best_for: Individuals and teams who want AI to timeblock their day, plan projects, and reduce manual scheduling and status meetings.
features: AI Task Manager that prioritizes and organizes tasks against available time
AI Project Manager that generates projects with tasks, deadlines, and assignees
AI Calendar Assistant that timeblocks and dynamically reschedules the day
Consolidated view across multiple calendar accounts
Automated meeting scheduling with booking links
AI Meeting Notetaker that records meetings and generates summaries and action items
Workflow builder for standard operating procedures

alternatives.name: Reclaim.ai
alternatives.description: An AI calendar assistant that automatically schedules meetings, tasks, habits, and focus time.
alternatives.best_for: People wanting AI to protect focus time and schedule tasks

alternatives.name: Calendly
alternatives.description: A scheduling tool that lets people share availability links to book meetings without back-and-forth emails.
alternatives.best_for: Individuals and teams booking one-off or recurring meetings

alternatives.name: Todoist
alternatives.description: A task management app for organizing personal and team to-do lists.
alternatives.best_for: Individuals and small teams tracking daily tasks

tiers.name: Pro AI
tiers.notes: Includes 7,500 AI credits/seat/month; overage billed at $0.25 per 100 additional credits.

tiers.name: Pro AI (paid annually)
tiers.notes: 33% cheaper than the monthly rate per Motion's own pricing page, but the discount requires paying the full year upfront in a single charge rather than in monthly installments. Billing basis: monthly rate, but charged as one lump-sum annual payment (~$153/seat for the year).

tiers.name: Business AI
tiers.notes: Includes 15,000 AI credits/seat/month; overage billed at $0.19 per 100 additional credits. Adds capacity planning, Gantt/timeline views, time tracking, permissions, central billing, priority support.

tiers.name: Business AI (paid annually)
tiers.notes: 33% cheaper than the monthly rate, same single-upfront-payment structure as Pro AI's annual option. Billing basis: monthly rate, but charged as one lump-sum annual payment (~$233/seat for the year).

cons: Motion's AI usage is metered, not unlimited: Pro AI includes 7,500 AI credits/seat/month and Business AI includes 15,000 credits/seat/month, and once those are used up you pay overage fees ($0.25 per 100 credits on Pro AI, $0.19 per 100 on Business AI) or wait for the next billing cycle — so the advertised $19 or $29 per-seat price is not a hard ceiling on cost for anyone doing heavy AI-assisted planning.

There is no permanent free plan, only a 7-day free trial, and per the official pricing page and a detailed third-party breakdown (usecarly.com), the trial requires entering credit card details upfront; when the 7 days end there is no automatic fallback to a free tier — the paid plan you selected starts billing automatically.

The 33%-cheaper annual rate isn't spread across 12 monthly charges — it's billed as a single lump-sum payment for the full year up front (roughly $153/seat for Pro AI or $233/seat for Business AI), which is a real structural gotcha for buyers expecting a lower recurring monthly charge rather than one large upfront bill.
